verdict.rationale: Pipedream workflows natively support event-driven triggers (webhooks, schedules, email, RSS, app-specific events) that fire automated multi-step actions including custom code, retries, and error handling, matching the core 'rules trigger actions on events' pattern. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for automating workflows in production. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of a declarative rule/condition-builder UI (vs. code-based logic) or benchmark of complex conditional automation depth beyond triggers+actions.
